story.soThat: communication failures are detected, reported, and recovered automatically

tasks.task: Create I2C wrapper with retry and recovery
Integrate i2c_wrapper into existing I2C users
Hook error counting into I2C failures (deferred from 4.10)

acceptanceCriteria.ac: I2C transaction timeouts detected within TIMING_I2C_TIMEOUT_MS (50ms)
Auto-retry on transient failures (up to TIMING_I2C_RETRY_COUNT=3)
Bus recovery on persistent failures (9 clock pulses, reinitialize)
Health degradation events published when failure count exceeds I2C_FAILURE_THRESHOLD
CMD_I2C returns bus health: OK I2C0:OK(1234) I2C1:OK(5678) or with error counts
CMD_I2C SCAN lists detected devices: OK 0x20:MCP23017 0x21:MCP23017 0x3C:OLED
Device offline detection after I2C_FAILURE_THRESHOLD consecutive failures
Graceful degradation when MCP23017s go offline (LIMITS_DEGRADED, FEEDBACK_DEGRADED events)

docs.doc: AC45-AC48: I2C health monitoring requirements. I2CHealthMonitor module specification. Bus recovery strategy: timeout -> retry -> reinitialize -> degraded mode.
FR46: Monitor I2C communication health. FR56: Detect I2C failures. FR58: Recover from transient errors. CMD_I2C and CMD_I2C SCAN response formats.
I2C_PORT=I2C_NUM_0, I2C_FREQ_HZ=400kHz. TIMING_I2C_TIMEOUT_MS=50, TIMING_I2C_RETRY_COUNT=3. Device addresses: 0x20 (MCP0), 0x21 (MCP1), 0x3C (OLED on I2C1).
ErrorManager integration: error_manager_increment(ERR_CAT_I2C, AXIS_NONE). Task 9 deferred I2C hook. Handler registration pattern, module initialization pattern, event publication pattern.
Header-only configuration: Use I2C_ADDR_MCP23017_0 never 0x20. Use TIMING_I2C_TIMEOUT_MS never 50.

constraints.constraint: Header-only configuration: Use I2C_ADDR_MCP23017_0 (0x20), never literal 0x20. Use TIMING_I2C_TIMEOUT_MS, TIMING_I2C_RETRY_COUNT from config headers.
Thread safety: I2C bus accessed from multiple tasks. Use FreeRTOS mutex for bus access. Follow mcp23017_wrapper mutex pattern.
Module initialization: Call i2c_health_init() from motor_system, following error_manager_init() pattern. Handler registration: Follow errcnt_handler pattern for i2c_handler.
System errors: EVENT ERROR SYSTEM E020 Device errors: EVENT ERROR I2C 0x21 Recovery: EVENT I2C RECOVERED Degradation: EVENT WARN LIMITS_DEGRADED, EVENT WARN FEEDBACK_DEGRADED
I2C health: OK I2C0:OK(1234) I2C1:OK(5678) I2C with errors: OK I2C0:WARN(1200/12) I2C1:OK(5678) I2C SCAN: OK 0x20:MCP23017 0x21:MCP23017 0x3C:OLED

1. Timeout -> retry once 2. Second failure -> reinitialize I2C bus 3. Third failure -> EVENT I2C_ERROR, switch to degraded mode 4. Bus recovery: Set SDA input, toggle SCL 9 times, STOP condition, reinitialize
Complete deferred Task 9 from Story 4.10: Hook error_manager_increment(ERR_CAT_I2C, AXIS_NONE, true) into I2C failure path.

tests.standards: Per project testing strategy: Unit tests acceptable, manual testing acceptable per DoD. Tests should verify timeout detection, retry logic, bus recovery, event publication, and command responses. Follow test patterns from Story 4.10 (error_manager).

ideas.idea: Test timeout detection: Mock I2C transaction that exceeds TIMING_I2C_TIMEOUT_MS
Test auto-retry: Mock transient failure followed by success, verify single operation completes
Test bus recovery: Mock persistent failures, verify 9 clock pulses sent, bus reinitialized
Test health events: Verify EVENT ERROR SYSTEM E020 when failure count exceeds threshold
Test CMD_I2C: Verify response format OK I2C0:OK(count) or WARN(success/failure)
Test CMD_I2C SCAN: Verify device discovery and offline marking
Test device offline: Verify device marked offline after consecutive failures
Test degradation: Verify LIMITS_DEGRADED event when MCP23017 #0 offline
